sets.theme: Male Lishi, moss-covered executioner battleaxe, full charcoal heavy armor edged with pale bone and muted bronze, restrained toxic-lime cracks. Spiky ash-white hair, small antler/branch crown, deep green cloth. Keep existing compact native fighter face and exact axe grip.
sets.prompt:
Use case: production pixel sprite parts, precise-object-edit for an EXISTING Godot RPG.
Image 1 is the editable native PARTS AND ICONS atlas. Image 2 is the user's necromancer theme reference ONLY, NEVER its painting style or proportions. Image 3 is the user's example of extravagant native-game hairstyle/shadow-face, relevant especially to the female mage.
Output a transparent PNG repaint of the SAME Image 1 atlas, EXACT 4 columns by 8 rows, same 1024x2048 canvas, same positions, relative sizes, orientations, bounding boxes and blank cells. Sparse layout is intentional: this is engine data. DO NOT reflow or compact the rows. Do NOT draw whole people in any cell.

Rows 1-5: repaint EACH native separate head, tiny body/arm/hand/leg component, and BOTH native weapon orientations in place. Preserve exact native body proportions, joint attachment positions and skin-color pixels on hands where applicable. ALL torso/chest/abdomen regions must be covered by the new costume, not bare pink skin. Leave all unused cells entirely transparent. Keep every tiny 1-pixel hand/stub tiny, do not expand it into a body.
Rows 6-8 contain exactly TEN isolated equipment icons, in this row-major order:
Row 6: weapon, NEW headwear/head design, armor/robe, paired wristguards.
Row 7: belt, trousers, paired boots, waist pendant.
Row 8: ring, necklace, EMPTY, EMPTY.
Completely redesign these ten ICONS to MATCH this set's wearable parts: consistent weapon shape, head design, colors, bone trim, green core and motifs. Not the old pink/orange source icons. The icons must be visually legible at 32px, flat 2-3 shades per material. Icons keep original center and occupy their individual cell, never crossing it.
Artwork style: exactly tiny native GAME PIXEL ART, strong simple clusters, coarse pixel grid as Image 1 (each source part pixel is 3x enlarged), hard silhouette. No realistic rendering, no smooth airbrush shading, no intricate high-resolution illustration or particle fog. Think native 2000s mobile Chinese pixel RPG, not new full-body character art.
Set design: Male Lishi, moss-covered executioner battleaxe, full charcoal heavy armor edged with pale bone and muted bronze, restrained toxic-lime cracks. Spiky ash-white hair, small antler/branch crown, deep green cloth. Keep existing compact native fighter face and exact axe grip.
Keep one consistent costume across all component poses, and all ten icons. Native weapon outline and HANDLE ATTACHMENT are authoritative; change material/motif and small tip details while preserving gripping geometry. Head may be non-human/skull-mask or shadowed where specified, still EXACT native pixel dimensions. Ivory/green bone motifs must be readable but sparse. True transparent alpha background, no grid lines, no labels, no watermark. Preserve all first-image native atlas alignment and empty cells; output only the sprite parts/icon atlas.
